en: Dependent on a mundane state, a mundane state arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a mundane state, a supramundane state arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a mundane state, both mundane and supramundane states arise by way of root condition.
Dependent on a supramundane state, a supramundane state arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on both mundane and supramundane states, a supramundane state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are five;
under object condition there are two ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are five. (The full detail applies everywhere.)
